records.source: Let's trim this a little here...
records.translation: Bawasan natin ito nang kaunti rito...

records.source: Here, let me use my finger to smudge this a bit...
records.translation: Heto, gagamitin ko ang daliri ko upang bahagyang pahiran ito...

records.source: Okay, get ready, this might be a tight fit...
records.translation: Sige, humanda ka, baka masikip ito...

records.source: Okay, I've got it!$h#$b#I'm coming in, so don't be alarmed!
records.translation: Sige, nakuha ko na!$h#$b#Papasok ako, kaya huwag kang magulat!

records.source: There!
records.translation: Ayan!

records.source: Yes! I can feel it, your inner self and outer self are now in perfect alignment!$h#$b#I can't wait for you to see the new 'you'!$h
records.translation: Oo! Nararamdaman ko, ganap nang nagtutugma ang panloob at panlabas mong sarili!$h#$b#Hindi ako makapaghintay na makita mo ang bago mong 'sarili'!$h

records.source: So? What do you think?#$b#I've put your old clothes in your backpack in case you change your mind!$h
records.translation: O? Ano sa palagay mo?#$b#Inilagay ko sa bag mo ang luma mong damit sakaling magbago ang isip mo!$h

records.preserveReason: Intentional ellipsis shown to the player; there is no linguistic content to translate.

records.source: Oops! That's my cue!
records.translation: Ay! Hudyat ko na iyon!

records.source: Knock, knock, honey! I'm coming in!
records.translation: Tok, tok, mahal! Papasok ako!

records.source: Let's see here...
records.translation: Tingnan natin...

records.source: Okay!
records.translation: Sige!

records.source: That was fun!$h#$b#I hope you're as happy with your new look as I am!$h
records.translation: Masaya iyon!$h#$b#Sana'y ikasiya mo ang bago mong hitsura gaya ng ikinasaya ko!$h

records.source: You're looking radiant!#$b#I've put your old clothes in your backpack in case you have a change of heart.$h
records.translation: Nagniningning ka!#$b#Inilagay ko sa bag mo ang luma mong damit sakaling magbago ang isip mo.$h

records.source: Hey, I grabbed some random stuff out of my closet. Want any of it?
records.translation: Hoy, kumuha ako ng kung anu-anong bagay sa aparador ko. May gusto ka ba rito?

records.source: See anything you like?
records.translation: May nakita ka bang gusto mo?

records.source: Ah, it feels good here in the shade.
records.translation: Ah, masarap dito sa lilim.

records.source: I had some extra wood, so I made these mini bookcases...
records.translation: May sobra akong kahoy, kaya ginawa ko ang maliliit na estante ng librong ito...

records.source: Oh, um... these are some model planes I built... do you like them?
records.translation: O, um... mga modelong eroplano ito na ginawa ko... gusto mo ba?

records.source: Psst... I'm selling eggs for cash! Hehe... Don't tell Lewis.
records.translation: Psst... Ibinebenta ko ang mga itlog kapalit ng pera! Hehe... Huwag mong sabihin kay Lewis.

records.source: Want my old broken skateboard? I guess you could use it for decoration or something.
records.translation: Gusto mo ang luma at sirang skateboard ko? Maaari mo sigurong gawing dekorasyon o kung ano man.
records.englishResidueReason: Skateboard is the conventional Filipino sports-equipment loanword.

records.source: I found some stuff by the lake.
records.translation: May nakita akong ilang bagay sa tabi ng lawa.

records.source: Hey, got any eggs?
records.translation: Hoy, may mga itlog ka ba?

records.source: Hello. I hope you see something you like.
records.translation: Kumusta. Sana ay may makita kang gusto mo.

records.source: In the mood for something delicious?
records.translation: Gusto mo ba ng masarap?

records.source: Some interesting things washed up on the beach. Care to trade?
records.translation: May ilang kawili-wiling bagay na naanod sa dalampasigan. Gusto mong makipagpalitan?

records.source: You'd better go find more eggs so you can buy all my stuff!
records.translation: Mabuting humanap ka pa ng mga itlog para mabili mo ang lahat ng paninda ko!

records.source: Do you have any eggs to trade? I'm studying the composition of the shell.
records.translation: May mga itlog ka bang maipagpapalit? Pinag-aaralan ko ang komposisyon ng balat.

records.source: Need any ores?
records.translation: Kailangan mo ba ng mga mineral?

records.source: Hey, check out this custom wallpaper I made. Want it?
records.translation: Hoy, tingnan mo ang pasadyang wallpaper na ginawa ko. Gusto mo ba?
records.englishResidueReason: Wallpaper is the conventional Filipino interior-design loanword.

records.source: Hehehe... Found some old beverages in the back of the fridge.
records.translation: Hehehe... May nakita akong mga lumang inumin sa likod ng pridyider.

records.source: Hi! I hope you find something you like.
records.translation: Kumusta! Sana ay may makita kang gusto mo.

records.source: Can I have some eggs? I want to put them in my nest.
records.translation: Maaari ba akong makahingi ng mga itlog? Gusto kong ilagay ang mga iyon sa pugad ko.

records.source: Hello dear. Please take your time, I'll be here all day!
records.translation: Kumusta, mahal. Huwag kang magmadali, narito ako buong araw!

records.source: I've got everything worth selling.
records.translation: Nasa akin ang lahat ng bagay na karapat-dapat ibenta.

records.source: I found an extra roll of wallpaper from my house. It's yours for 20 eggs!
records.translation: May nakita akong sobrang rolyo ng wallpaper sa bahay ko. Iyo na ito kapalit ng 20 itlog!
records.englishResidueReason: Wallpaper is the conventional Filipino interior-design loanword.

records.source: Found some food in the freezer. It's yours for cheap. Just don't look at the expiration date.
records.translation: May nakita akong pagkain sa freezer. Mura lang ito. Huwag mo lang tingnan ang petsa ng pagkapaso.
records.englishResidueReason: Freezer is the conventional Filipino appliance loanword.

records.source: Hi... Um... *giggle*
records.translation: Kumusta... Um... *hagikgik*

records.source: I'm sorry, my selection isn't very good this year...
records.translation: Paumanhin, hindi gaanong maganda ang mga paninda ko ngayong taon...

records.source: Hi! Um... I found some stuff. Wanna buy it!?
records.translation: Kumusta! Um... May nakita akong ilang bagay. Gusto mo bang bilhin!?
